about: The dataset literals no shared template may carry (D6 §10.6, §15.2; BUILD-PLAN R-F10: the one deny-list gate). lint_templates.py scans every shared template for the hard and the soft tokens and for every lane generator's VOCAB; a shared template belongs to no lane, so a soft token is a hit there too. The page smoke (P-LEAK) reads the same file: a hard token never appears in a non-G00 page, a soft token only in a page whose lane VOCAB holds it. Each regex is Python `re` syntax and says which sense of the word is the dataset's: a word English uses in a second sense (a CUDA-graph capture, an architecture port, Python's zip) is matched only in the dataset's sense.

hard.note: the project's name: CIDS, cids, cids-serve, CIDS_BUNDLE
also the v2.2 page's .threat class (the role map says role-alert)
the intrusion detection system, by its acronym (v2.2 domain.py's "an IDS answer", D3 G7, D2 gap 11); lower-case ids (identifiers) is not this sense

soft.note: the traffic capture (a capture day, capture order, the capture's own spelling); a CUDA-graph capture is not this sense
CIC's label column, by its spelling
a network port as a data column (a port sent as a number or as text); an architecture port or a service's TCP port is not this sense
the CIC flow extractor that writes the Infinity tokens
the acceptance fixture's column; Python's and JavaScript's zip( is not this sense

the network traffic CIC classifies: v2.2 domain.py's TrafficClass (D3 G7, D2 gap 11), the v2.2 page's #traffic field; soft because a lane may bring the word in its own sense (L21's roads: a traffic network)
the acceptance fixture by its name (orders.csv, the orders fixture); the verb is not this sense
